description: This file defines a validation rule class 'TimesheetCommentDateParamRule' used in the OrangeHRM Time plugin to validate dates associated with timesheet comments. It checks whether a provided date falls within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet identified by an ID.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentDateParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies if a given date falls within the timesheet's start and end dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the provided date string is within the timesheet's date range.
